1	# Nxeon marketing site redesign: handoff
2	
3	This package holds everything built during the redesign of the Nxeon marketing site (nxeon.cloud):
4	31 finished pages, the build system that produced them, all assets, and the decisions behind them.
5	
6	The live site is a **Next.js** app. The pages here are **standalone reference implementations**:
7	pixel-accurate, working HTML/CSS/JS that production should reproduce as Next.js components.
8	They are not meant to be dropped in as-is (images are inlined as base64, cross-links point at temporary preview URLs).
9	
10	---
11	
12	## 1. What's in the package
13	
14	| Folder | Contents |
15	|---|---|
16	| `dist/` | The 31 finished pages as single self-contained HTML files, exactly as reviewed and approved. Open any of them in a browser. |
17	| `source/` | The build system: shared CSS/JS/markup, one folder per page, and the Python builders that assemble them. |
18	| `assets/` | Every image the pages use: logos, game artwork, maps, generated backdrops, renders, nav thumbnails. |
19	| `docs/` | This guide, the page inventory, the URL map, and open items. |
20	| `skills/` | Skills for Claude Code: frontend-design (used for this work), nxeon-design-system, nxeon-page-workflow (with verification scripts), nxeon-content-integrity. |
21	| `CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT.md` | The prompt to continue the work in Claude Code. |
22	
23	### Rebuilding
24	Requirements: Python 3.10+ (standard library only for building). Pillow is only needed to regenerate images; Playwright only for screenshot tools.
25	
26	```
27	cd source
28	python3 build_page.py contact      # rebuild one page into ../dist/nxeon-contact.html
29	sh rebuild_all.sh                  # rebuild everything
30	```
31	The package was verified to rebuild byte-identical output from these folders.
32	
33	---
34	
35	## 2. How the build system works
36	
37	Every page = **shared shell** + **page folder**.
38	
39	**Shared shell** (used by every page):
40	- `source/part1.html`: `<head>` and the global stylesheet (base styles, homepage styles, the nav, the footer).
41	- `source/part2.html`: the SVG icon sprite (`#i-*` symbols), the nav `<header>`, the homepage body, the footer.
42	- `source/part3.html`: global JavaScript (nav behaviour, reveal-on-scroll, counters, homepage modules).
43	- `source/pages/common.css`: styles shared by all inner pages.
44	- `source/pages/aurora.css` + `aurora.js` / `aurora.built.js`: **Aurora UI**, the component design system (see section 3).
45	
46	**Page folder** `source/pages/<slug>/`:
47	- `body.html` (page markup with `{{SPRITE}}`, `{{NAV}}`, `{{FOOTER}}` placeholders)
48	- `page.css`, `page.js`
49	- `meta.json` (title, description, in-page anchors, and the images the page needs as `__IMG_KEY__` placeholders)
50	
51	**`build_page.py <slug>`** stitches shell + folder, inlines images as base64, rewrites nav links so they work
52	from any page, and writes `../dist/nxeon-<slug>.html`.
53	- `assemble.py` builds the homepage (`dist/nxeon.html`).
54	- `build_games2.py` builds the game-servers hub.
55	
56	**Generators** create page folders from data, then call `build_page.py`:
57	
58	| Builder | Produces | Data lives in |
59	|---|---|---|
60	| `build_gs2.py game` / `build_gs2.py loc` | Minecraft hosting page, Minecraft in Singapore (the conversion template for all game servers) | `MC` + `TIERS` in `build_gameserver.py`, `SPEC`/`TINFO` in `build_gs2.py`, `LOC` in `build_location.py` |
61	| `loc_render.py <slug>` | VPS location pages (Singapore, Germany) with real dot maps | `build_location.py` (`LOC`), `assets/maps/` |
62	| `build_usecase.py <slug>` | WordPress / Docker use-case pages | `USE` in `build_usecase.py`, `EXTRA` in `use_extra.py` |
63	| `build_compare.py <slug>` | Nxeon vs competitor pages (template in `pages/_cmp/`) | `CMP` in `build_compare.py` |
64	| `build_modsgame.py minecraft` | NxLabs mods-per-game page | `GAMES` in `build_modsgame.py`, `pages/mc_catalog.json` |
65	| `build_modsbrowse.py` | "All Minecraft mods" paginated browse page | `pages/mc_catalog.json` |
66	| `build_modpage.py` | Individual mod page (Lithium) | `LITHIUM` dict in `build_modpage.py`, `mod_tags.py` |
67	| `build_blogpost.py` | Blog article template (Vaultwarden) | `A` dict in `build_blogpost.py` |
68	| `build_bloghub.py` | Blog hub | `P` list in `build_bloghub.py` |
69	| `build_blogvisuals.py` | Blog cover visual system (archetypes + logos + palettes) | `GUIDES` in `build_blogvisuals.py`, `pages/_logos.json` |
70	
71	Shared components used by several builders: `mods_ui.py` (mod cards), `mod_tags.py` (tag-driven illustrations),
72	`pages/_shield.*` (Nxeon Shield DDoS section, extracted from the homepage), `pages/_modscards.css` (cards + carousels),
73	`pages/_gs*.{css,js}` (game-server builder, world picker, sticky deploy bar).
74	
75	Class-name rule used throughout: every page's classes are namespaced to avoid collisions with the global stylesheet.
76	Several bugs during the build came from collisions (`.mcard`, `.shr`, `.sp`, `.bar`, the `wait` helper).
77	Check new names against `part1.html`, `common.css` and `aurora.css` before using them.
78	
79	---
80	
81	## 3. Design system
82	
83	**Typography:** Plus Jakarta Sans (display + body), a monospace for code and data. Fonts are in `source/fonts/`.
84	
85	**Colour:** dark base (`--bg` near #060913), ink #EEF1FA, secondary ink ~#A9B1CE, muted ~#7A83A6.
86	Aurora accents: cyan #3EDCF2, blue #4E6BFF, violet #7B5CFF/#9B6BFF, magenta #E04BD6/#FF5FD7, mint #3FD89A, amber #FFB36B/#FFD27A (reserved for "custom / enterprise").
87	
88	**Aurora UI components** (`pages/aurora.css`, `aurora.js`; live reference page: `dist/nxeon-aurora-ui.html`):
89	buttons (`au-btn`, `--glass`, `--ghost`), segmented control (`au-seg`), cards with pointer spotlight (`au-card`),
90	search (`au-search`), range slider (`au-range`), toggle (`au-toggle`), chips, animated icon set (`data-au-icon`),
91	count-up (`data-au-count`, formats with thousands separators), gauges, sparklines, toasts (`auToast`),
92	FAQ accordion (`.faq details`, smooth height, soft glow that fades out past each item).
93	
94	**Glass card tiers** (homepage and inner pages): *quiet* (neutral glass, colour only as a top hairline, lights up on hover),
95	*medium* (soft tint of the card's product colour), *vivid* (full glow, used sparingly: the featured VPS price card, the Creator panel).
96	Palettes follow meaning: mint = savings/success, amber = effort or custom/enterprise, brand colours for competitors.
97	
98	**Nav** (`part2.html` header + `part1.html` NAV v2 styles + `part3.html` Navigation script):
99	- Top level: Products (mega menu), Matrix, Pricing, Compare, NxLabs (inline "Game Mod Store" badge), Company (menu); right: Status pill, Log in, Get started.
100	- **Products** uses Nxeon's real columns: Compute / Storage and network / Web essentials / By use case (on its own soft panel, with "All features"), plus a popular game servers strip with artwork.
101	- **Company:** About, Blog, Security, Contact, Affiliate program, Status, plus the latest guide.
102	- One shared dropdown morphs between menus.
103	  - **Mouse:** hover opens with intent delay.
104	  - **Keyboard:** click or ArrowDown opens; Escape closes and returns focus.
105	  - **Closed state:** the dropdown can't be tabbed into.
106	- Full-screen sheet on mobile.
107	- Logged-in state should drop "My account" / "Back to portal" into the Log in / Get started slot.
108	
109	**Matrix page** deliberately uses its own language (after Cursor / Grok / OpenClaw):
110	- **Opening:** black canvas, a horizon glow and a big prompt box.
111	- **Product:** a realistic app window on painted backdrops, with a tech-logo row.
112	- **Buttons:** white.
113	- **Motion:** only where it is the product.
114	
115	**Blog cover visual system:** each guide gets an automatic cover.
116	- **Archetypes by topic:** flow, terminal, shield, stack, vault, chart, route. Game guides use game artwork.
117	- **Logos:** official brand logos from its tags, via Simple Icons (`pages/_logos.json`).
118	- **Palettes:** chosen by category.
119	- **Motion:** covers show their finished state and only play ambient motion on hover.
120	
121	---
122	
123	## 4. Design direction (what the stakeholder asked for; keep to it)
124	
125	- **Premium and considered, never "vibe coded".** Too many animations read as cheap; too plain reads as a regression.
126	  Target: motion only where it demonstrates the product, confident typography, generous space, real product UI.
127	- **Real data only.** Every claim, price, count and list came from the live nxeon.cloud pages or the source it cites.
128	  Where data didn't exist, it is marked as a placeholder (see OPEN-ITEMS.md). Never invent customer quotes, stats or specs.
129	- **Conversion pages must not be brushed off.** Game-server pages carry:
130	  - a deploy console in the hero
131	  - the Nxeon Shield DDoS section
132	  - a "Choose your world" picker with CPU, RAM and NVMe resources plus a fit calculator
133	  - a sticky deploy bar
134	  - custom-server CTAs (gold) linking to `/contact?topic=custom`
135	  - an objection-handling FAQ
136	- **Glassmorphism with restraint:** dark crisp glass, colour in controlled places, no grain, no milky washes.
137	- **Game hero images:** game page = the game's own art; game × location page = game art blended into the city image.
138	
139	---
140	
141	## 5. Page inventory
142	
143	| Page | File (dist/) | Production route | Built by | Source of content |
144	|---|---|---|---|---|
145	| Homepage | nxeon.html | / | assemble.py | live homepage |
146	| Matrix (flagship) | nxeon-matrix.html | /matrix | pages/matrix | live /matrix |
147	| Pricing | nxeon-pricing.html | /pricing | pages/pricing | live pricing data |
148	| Cloud VPS | nxeon-vps.html | /vps | pages/vps | live |
149	| Web hosting | nxeon-web-hosting.html | /web-hosting | pages/web-hosting | live |
150	| Business email | nxeon-business-email.html | /business-email | pages/business-email | live |
151	| Domains | nxeon-domains.html | /domains | pages/domains | live |
152	| NxCloud | nxeon-nxcloud.html | TBD | pages/nxcloud | live |
153	| Free migration | nxeon-migrate.html | /migrate | pages/migrate | live |
154	| Free VPS | nxeon-free-vps.html | /free-vps | pages/free-vps | live |
155	| Free Minecraft | nxeon-free-minecraft.html | /free-minecraft | pages/free-minecraft | live |
156	| Singapore VPS | nxeon-singapore-vps-hosting.html | /singapore-vps-hosting | loc_render.py | live |
157	| Germany VPS | nxeon-germany-vps-hosting.html | /germany-vps-hosting | loc_render.py | live |
158	| WordPress VPS | nxeon-wordpress-vps-hosting.html | /wordpress-vps-hosting | build_usecase.py | live |
159	| Docker hosting | nxeon-docker-hosting.html | /docker-hosting | build_usecase.py | live |
160	| Compare hub | nxeon-compare.html | /compare | pages/compare | live |
161	| Nxeon vs DigitalOcean | nxeon-vps-vs-digitalocean.html | /vps-vs-digitalocean | build_compare.py | live + DigitalOcean public pricing (Sept 2026) |
162	| Game servers hub | nxeon-game-servers.html | /game-servers | build_games2.py | live |
163	| Minecraft hosting | nxeon-minecraft-server-hosting.html | /minecraft-server-hosting | build_gs2.py game | live + pricing panel tiers |
164	| Minecraft in Singapore | nxeon-minecraft-server-hosting-singapore.html | TBD | build_gs2.py loc | live |
165	| Minecraft in Falkenstein | nxeon-minecraft-server-hosting-germany.html | TBD | build_gameloc.py (older template, regenerate with build_gs2) | live |
166	| Valheim hosting | nxeon-valheim.html | /valheim-server-hosting | pages/valheim (older template) | live |
167	| NxLabs hub | nxeon-nxlabs.html | /mods | pages/nxlabs | live /mods |
168	| Minecraft mods | nxeon-mods-minecraft.html | /mods/games/minecraft | build_modsgame.py | live /mods |
169	| All Minecraft mods (browse) | nxeon-mods-minecraft-browse.html | TBD | build_modsbrowse.py | live /mods |
170	| Lithium mod page | nxeon-mod-lithium.html | /mods/minecraft/lithium | build_modpage.py | live /mods + Modrinth/GitHub/CurseForge |
171	| Blog hub | nxeon-blog.html | /blog | build_bloghub.py | live /blog |
172	| Blog article | nxeon-blog-vaultwarden-nginx.html | /blog/<slug> | build_blogpost.py | live article |
173	| Contact | nxeon-contact.html | /contact | pages/contact | live /contact |
174	| Blog cover system (demo) | nxeon-blog-visuals.html | internal | build_blogvisuals.py | live guides |
175	| Aurora UI reference | nxeon-aurora-ui.html | internal | pages/aurora-ui | design system |
176	
177	`docs/url-map.json` maps every temporary preview URL used in cross-links to its production route.
178	
179	---
180	
181	## 6. Porting to production (Next.js) notes
182	- Recreate the shared shell as layout components (Nav, Footer) and Aurora UI as a component library; keep the CSS tokens.
183	- Replace base64-inlined images with files in `/public` and `next/image`. Sources are all in `assets/`.
184	- Replace preview URLs using `docs/url-map.json`.
185	- **Contact form and newsletter need real endpoints.**
186	  - **Contact:** topic, plan and scale are ready for routing.
187	  - **Deep links:** `?topic=custom|migrate|partner|vps|game|support|billing|bug|general` pre-selects the form.
188	- Catalogue-driven pages (mods, blog, game servers) should read from the same data the live site uses, not the snapshots here.
189	- Keep `prefers-reduced-motion` handling (present throughout) and the keyboard behaviour of the nav, menus, carousels and FAQs.
190

1	# Open items
2	
3	## A. Needs confirmation before launch
4	1. **Game-server tier prices.** The Minecraft plans (1 GB $2.99 … 16 GB $32.99) are marked as preview figures in the pricing panel; only Valheim's are marked live.
5	2. **Game-server CPU and NVMe specs are placeholders**, modelled on the VPS plans: 1 GB = 1 vCPU/15 GB, 2 GB = 1/25, 4 GB = 2/50, 6 GB = 2/65, 8 GB = 3/80, 12 GB = 4/100, 16 GB = 4/120. Edit `SPEC` in `source/build_gs2.py`.
6	3. **Fit-calculator and modpack-guide numbers are sizing heuristics.** Edit `PACK` in `pages/_gs3.js` and `TINFO` in `build_gs2.py`.
7	4. **Nav links with unknown routes.** Dedicated IPv4 points to /vps#ipv4, and "AI apps and agents" points to /features.
8	5. **Custom / enterprise route.** Custom-server CTAs go to `/contact?topic=custom`. Confirm, or supply a dedicated enterprise page or booking link.
9	6. **Review badges.** Trustpilot 4.9 (312), HostAdvice 4.8 (148) and Google 4.9 (205) are copied from the live site, where they link to `#`. Verify the figures and link them to the real profiles.
10	7. **Routes marked TBD** in `docs/url-map.json`: NxCloud, game × location pages, and the mods browse page.
11	8. **Logged-in nav state.** "My account" / "Back to portal" go in the Log in / Get started slot.
12	
13	## B. Pages still to build (templates exist for most)
14	- **From existing templates:**
15	  - the other ~46 game-server pages (`build_gs2.py`: add a game dict like `MC`)
16	  - game × location pages
17	  - a Valheim rebuild on the new template
18	  - regenerating Minecraft in Falkenstein
19	- **Comparisons:** 9 remaining (Hostinger, GoDaddy, Bluehost, Namecheap, HostGator, Cloudways, IONOS, Kamatera, A2 Hosting). Needs competitor logos and current pricing; add entries to `CMP` in `build_compare.py`.
20	- **Migration guides:** the 10 "migrate from [host]" pages.
21	- **NxLabs, other games:** mods pages for the other 32 games (`build_modsgame.py`), and more mod pages (`build_modpage.py`). Add more illustrations to `mod_tags.py` for the categories that matter.
22	- **Blog:**
23	  - the full archive and category pages (the hub currently holds 25 real guides)
24	  - covers for every guide via the visual system
25	- **New designs:**
26	  - Vibe coding
27	  - Features (Claude AI builder)
28	  - Server directory
29	  - Free tools hub, plus Minecraft server status, server size calculator and ping/latency test
30	  - Status
31	  - About, Security, Developers, Docs and Affiliate
32	  - Cheap VPS, Gaming VPS, Block storage and Game-server mod support
33	  - Legal: Terms, Privacy, Acceptable Use and SLA
34	- **Wiring:** the contact form, newsletter and "Add to my server" flows are demos and need backends.
35	
36	## C. Issues found on the live site
37	- **Matrix:** the stats band shows "0 consoles", "~$0" and "0%" because the count-up never runs.
38	- **Contact:** reads "~1 one business day", a typo.
39	- **Support promise is inconsistent:** "within one business day" (Contact) vs "24/7 support" and "answers around the clock" elsewhere.
40	- **Pricing contradicts itself:** "never increases at renewal" vs "intro price for your first term, then … regular price".
41	- **Managed vs self-managed:** both claims appear.
42	- **Regions:** the homepage "global network" section lists Toronto, New York, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney, while the site elsewhere says Singapore and Germany data centres only.
43	- **Blog:**
44	  - an unrelated game-server panel screenshot appears inside non-game articles (Vaultwarden, Linux tuning)
45	  - the internal tag `#seobatch` is public (tag list and article meta)
46	  - index cards mostly lack dates
47	  - "Read more" appears inconsistently
48	- **Naming:** the site mixes "Claude CLI" and "Claude Code"; Anthropic's product is Claude Code.
49	- **Imagery:** the panel screenshots and renders show a real-looking server IP (178.63.94.114). One render lists a Canada location and old prices. The mods collage uses recognisable game characters.

  **`lib/renewal-charge.ts`** — the single `renewalCharge(server: PricedServer, prices: RenewalPrices): RenewalCharge` function. Order of operations: resolve term months → resolve price (grandfathered override wins over live `plan.priceCents`/`gamePlan.priceCents`) → apply annual-term discount (`termPriceCents`/`vpsTermPriceCents` from `lib/billing-terms.ts`) → add IP/disk/backup add-ons → subtract one-time retention discount → subtract Creator Partner recurring discount (`lib/partner-discount.ts` `partnerDiscountCentsFor`) → add tax. Comment explicitly warns this is the ONE formula (a past incident had a hardcoded duplicate that undercharged).
  
  **`lib/promotions.ts`** — single promo model, `FIRST_MONTH_FREE` (100% off first term), `currentPromo(now)`, `promoPriceCents()`, `discountedCents()`. Scope-gated to shared hosting only via `lib/promo-redemption.ts` `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo("HOSTING")` — VPS/game/email never see it.
  
  **Geo currency display** — `next.config.ts` line 91 confirms `geoip-lite` is in `serverExternalPackages`. Flow: `lib/geo-ip.ts` (`countryFromRequestIp`, wraps geoip-lite) + `lib/geo-currency.ts` (`currencyForCountry`, `countryFromHeaders` — CDN header first, geoip-lite fallback) → `lib/currency-display.ts` `resolveDisplayCurrency()` (server-only; precedence: cookie > CDN/proxy header > geoip-lite IP lookup > admin default Setting). This is DISPLAY ONLY — charge currency is always USD (explicitly documented in the file). I did not find this called from the marketing `/pricing` page itself (that page renders raw USD cents); it's used in dashboard/checkout-adjacent surfaces reading `resolveDisplayCurrency()`.
  
  **Marketing pricing page**: `/opt/nxeon/app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx`, exported default `PricingPage()`, `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`. It queries the DB directly and live on every request — `db.plan.findMany({where:{active:true}})`, `db.hostingPlan.findMany(...)`, `db.emailPlan.findMany(...)`, `db.gamePlan.findMany(...)` — plus live admin settings (`annualDiscountPct()`, `backupPlusMonthlyCents()`, `extraDiskPerGbCents()`) and `planIntroMonthlyCents()` from `lib/intro-pricing.ts`. Nothing on this page is a static config or hardcoded number; a catalog/admin-setting edit propagates immediately. It hands the shaped data to `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`.
  
  ## 2. GAMES CATALOG
  
  **`/opt/nxeon/lib/games.ts`** is the canonical static list: `GAME_FAMILIES` (const array, line 2) has **52 entries**; `GAME_DISPLAY` (line 19) maps each to `{name, glyph}`. Pure static TS — **no `Game` DB model exists** (confirmed: `grep "^model Game "` on schema.prisma returns nothing). Only 47 of the 52 families currently have an active `GamePlan` row (live DB count above); the marketing pricing page filters with `GAME_FAMILIES.filter(f => byGame.get(f)?.length > 0)` so unseeded families don't render.
  - Pricing/tiers per game: **separate `GamePlan` model**, not reuse of `Plan` directly — each `GamePlan` references a `basePlanId` (FK into `Plan`) purely to size/provision the underlying VM, but price/RAM/disk/slots live on `GamePlan` itself.
  - `lib/nx/catalog.ts` has `GAMES_COUNT_BULLET = "__GAMES_COUNT__ supported games"` — a placeholder string substituted at render time with the real count, specifically flagged in a comment as a fix for a previously hardcoded wrong number ("41 supported games").
  
  ## 3. REGIONS / NODES
  
  **`Node` model** (`prisma/schema.prisma` line 1486): `region` (plain string, validated in code not DB — `lib/node-regions.ts`), `provider` (enum `NodeProvider`: OVH/HETZNER), `capacityRamMB`, `enabled`, `acceptsProvisions` (admin-only "stop landing new work here" toggle, distinct from `enabled`), `status` (NodeStatus enum).
  - `lib/node-regions.ts`: `NODE_REGIONS` lists *possible* datacenter codes per provider (OVH: sgp1/bhs1/gra1/rbx1/waw1; Hetzner: fsn1/nbg1/hel1/ash1/hil1) — these are not all live, just valid.
  - **Live DB reality** (queried directly): 4 `Node` rows exist — `primary`/`node-3`/`node-4` in `sgp1` (OVH) and `node-2` in `fsn1` (Hetzner). **2 distinct live regions.**
  - Capacity/stock: `lib/node-capacity.ts` computes per-node utilization (CPU/RAM/DISK, `nodeThresholds()`, `NODE_CAP_DEFAULT_WARN/CRIT`) but this is an **admin-only** alerting surface (`/admin/infrastructure`, `NodeAlert` model) — it is NOT exposed to the marketing site or the deploy wizard. There is no customer-facing "X slots left in this region" or "sold out" concept anywhere (confirmed via grep across marketing/dashboard-deploy — no hits).
  
  **Deploy wizard region picker** (`app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx` line 131): `db.node.findMany({where:{enabled:true}}, select: {id, region})` — queried live, per-request, dynamic. Passed to `lib/nx/catalog.ts` `regionsFrom(nodes)` (line 77), which groups by region and only offers a region if it has coordinates defined (`COORDS[region]`) — filters on `enabled` only, NOT `acceptsProvisions` and NOT capacity. `defaultRegionKey()` (line 128) picks the visitor's nearest region (EU visitor → Europe region if one exists, else `sgp1`, else first).
  
  **Answer to "does checkout read live availability before letting someone pick a region/plan"**: Partially. It reads a live list of *enabled Nodes* (so a region with zero nodes, or one whose only node was disabled, simply won't appear) — that part is real and live. It does NOT check per-node capacity/utilization or `acceptsProvisions` before offering a region; those are enforced later, server-side, by the actual provisioning scheduler (worker), not surfaced to the customer as a stock/availability signal.
  
  ## Summary counts (live DB, 2026-09-27)
  - VPS plans: 4 active — Hosting plans: 3 active — Email plans: 3 active
  - Game plans: 135 active rows across 47 families (of 52 defined in `lib/games.ts`)
  - Nodes: 4 total, 2 distinct live regions (Singapore/sgp1, Falkenstein DE/fsn1)
  
</agent-message>

input.content:
# Backend wiring gaps — new static marketing site vs live Nxeon platform

Scope: read-only audit. Compares the live Next.js app at `/opt/nxeon` (branch `main`) against the static
design package at `/root/nxeon-marketing-v1/src/New Marketing Website v1/nxeon-website-handoff/`
(`dist/` = 31 approved standalone HTML pages, `source/` = Python build system + baked JSON snapshots,
`docs/HANDOFF.md` + `docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md` = the design team's own notes). Nothing was changed; no build was run.

All live-side facts below were confirmed by reading source under `/opt/nxeon` and, where noted, a live
read-only query against the production Postgres DB `nxeon` on 2026-09-27. All counts are as of that date
and will drift (mods/blog/games catalogs grow continuously) — treat exact counts as "true as of this audit,"
not permanent.

---

## 1. Catalog data — plans, prices, games, regions, stock

### Plans & pricing
- **Prisma models** (`prisma/schema.prisma`): `Plan` (VPS, line ~639), `GamePlan` (per-game tier, line ~3047,
  FK `basePlanId` → `Plan` for provisioning size only — price/RAM/disk/slots live on `GamePlan` itself),
  `HostingPlan` (~1877, shared hosting), `EmailPlan` (~2657, business email). Common shape: `priceCents`,
  `introPriceCents`/`introTermMonths` (grandfather-program intro pricing), `active`, `sortOrder`.
- **Live counts (DB, 2026-09-27):** 4 active `Plan` rows, 3 active `HostingPlan`, 3 active `EmailPlan`,
  **135 active `GamePlan` rows across 47 game families** (of 52 families defined in `lib/games.ts`).
- **Renewal/actual-charge logic:** `lib/renewal-charge.ts`, single function `renewalCharge(server, prices)`.
  Order: resolve term → resolve price (per-customer `Server.grandfatheredRenewalCents` override beats the
  live `plan.priceCents`/`gamePlan.priceCents`) → apply annual-term discount from `lib/billing-terms.ts`
  → add IP/disk/backup add-ons → subtract one-time retention discount (`Server.pendingRenewalDiscountPercent`)
  → subtract Creator Partner recurring discount (`lib/partner-discount.ts` `partnerDiscountCentsFor`) → add
  tax. File comment explicitly warns this is the *one* formula after a past incident duplicated it and
  undercharged live customers — **any new pricing surface must call this, never re-derive a number.**
- **Annual discount:** global admin `Setting` `annual_discount_percent`, resolved via
  `lib/annual-discount.ts` → `annualDiscountPct()`. Not per-plan.
- **Promotions:** `lib/promotions.ts` — single promo model `FIRST_MONTH_FREE` (100% off first term),
  `currentPromo(now)` / `promoPriceCents()` / `discountedCents()`. Scope-gated to **shared hosting only**
  via `lib/promo-redemption.ts`'s `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo("HOSTING")` (per memory: hosting-only, never VPS/
  game/email — new marketing copy must not imply otherwise).
- **Geo display currency:** `geoip-lite` is in `next.config.ts`'s `serverExternalPackages` (line ~91).
  Flow: `lib/geo-ip.ts` (`countryFromRequestIp`) + `lib/geo-currency.ts` (`currencyForCountry`,
  `countryFromHeaders`) → `lib/currency-display.ts`'s `resolveDisplayCurrency()` (precedence: cookie > CDN
  header > geoip-lite IP > admin default `Setting`). **Display only — charges are always USD**
  (documented in the file itself). The live marketing `/pricing` page does **not** call this; it renders
  raw USD cents. The switcher lives in `components/currency/CurrencySwitcher.tsx` +
  `components/currency/CurrencyContext.tsx` (cookie-persisted), used via `useDisplayMoney()`.
- **Marketing pricing page today:** `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx`, `export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic"`. Queries `db.plan.findMany({where:{active:true}})`, `db.hostingPlan.findMany(...)`,
  `db.emailPlan.findMany(...)`, `db.gamePlan.findMany(...)` live, plus `annualDiscountPct()`,
  `backupPlusMonthlyCents()`, `extraDiskPerGbCents()`, `planIntroMonthlyCents()` (`lib/intro-pricing.ts`).
  Feeds `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. **Nothing here is static — every number is a live
  read.** This is the target the new `/pricing` page must reproduce, not a config file to copy values from.

### New site's pricing today
`dist/nxeon-pricing.html` (built by `source/pages/pricing/`, `meta.json` + hand-typed content) has the
Minecraft tier prices (1 GB $2.99 … 16 GB $32.99) explicitly flagged in `OPEN-ITEMS.md §A.1` as **preview
figures**; only Valheim's are marked live. CPU/NVMe specs per tier (`SPEC` in `source/build_gs2.py`) are
explicitly flagged as **placeholders modelled on VPS plans**, not real `GamePlan` data. **Nothing in the
new site queries the DB — every number is baked at build time into static HTML.**

### Games catalog
- Canonical list: `lib/games.ts` — `GAME_FAMILIES` (52 entries, static TS array, **no `Game` DB model
  exists** — confirmed via schema grep) + `GAME_DISPLAY` (name/glyph map). There is no export literally
  named `GAME_META`; related exports used elsewhere are `GAME_DISPLAY`, `GAME_PORT`, `GAME_ART_SLUG`,
  `GAME_GENRES`, and `ACTIVE_GAME_FAMILIES` (41, in `lib/marketing/gameLocationLandings.ts`).
  `lib/nx/catalog.ts` even has a `GAMES_COUNT_BULLET = "__GAMES_COUNT__ supported games"` placeholder
  substituted at render time — a comment there says this replaced a **previously hardcoded wrong count**
  ("41 supported games"). This is the exact bug pattern the new static site risks repeating.
- New site: `source/pages/nxlabs/games.json` (1,578 bytes, small fixed list) and the game-server pricing
  panel's `MC`/`TIERS` dicts in `source/build_gameserver.py` — static, will not track `lib/games.ts` or
  `GamePlan` as either changes.

### Regions / nodes / stock
- **`Node` model** (schema ~line 1486): `region` (free string, validated in code via
  `lib/node-regions.ts`, not a DB enum), `provider` (`NodeProvider`: OVH/HETZNER), `capacityRamMB`,
  `enabled`, `acceptsProvisions`, `status`.
- **Live reality (DB):** 4 `Node` rows — 3 in `sgp1` (OVH, incl. `primary`) + 1 in `fsn1` (Hetzner) =
  **2 distinct live regions today: Singapore and Falkenstein, Germany.**
- Deploy wizard region picker (`app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx`): `db.node.findMany({enabled:true})` read
  live, per request → `lib/nx/catalog.ts`'s `regionsFrom(nodes)` groups by region (only regions with
  `COORDS[region]` defined show up) → `defaultRegionKey()` geo-picks the nearest.
- **Stock/availability:** `lib/node-capacity.ts` computes per-node CPU/RAM/disk utilization with
  warn/crit thresholds, but that surface is **admin-only** (`/admin/infrastructure`, `NodeAlert` model) —
  it is never exposed to the marketing site or the deploy wizard. There is **no customer-facing "N slots
  left" or "sold out" concept anywhere** in the live product. `acceptsProvisions` and real capacity are
  enforced later, server-side, by the worker/scheduler — not surfaced as a stock signal to the buyer.
- **New site:** the homepage "global network" section (per `OPEN-ITEMS.md §C`) lists 7 regions (Toronto,
  New York, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney) — **5 of these don't exist as live `Node`
  regions today.** This is a live-site inconsistency the design docs flag but haven't resolved; a rebuild
  must decide the real, honest region list (Singapore + Falkenstein, or Falkenstein under a "Germany"
  label) rather than porting the aspirational 7-region copy forward.

**Every number on the new pricing/game/VPS pages must ultimately come from:** `db.plan`, `db.gamePlan`,
`db.hostingPlan`, `db.emailPlan` (via the same query shapes as `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx`),
`lib/annual-discount.ts`, `lib/intro-pricing.ts`, `lib/renewal-charge.ts` (for any "then $X/mo after intro"
copy), `lib/games.ts` for the game list, and `db.node` (`enabled:true`) for regions — never a snapshot.

---

## 2. Mods / NxLabs

### Live system
- **Prisma models:** `GameMod` (schema ~3078) — `gameFamily, name, slug, category, source, sourceId, url,
  description, iconUrl, popularity, paid, featured, active`, plus verified-upstream fields

  Hosting 7, Control Panels 4, Game servers 1.
- **No dedicated `/blog/category/[cat]` route** — category is a display label only, not a filterable URL.
- **Search:** real server-side Prisma in `lib/blog.ts` (`searchPublishedPosts`/`publishedWhere`,
  case-insensitive `contains` across title/excerpt/body/category + exact tag match), paginated
  (`getPostsPage`, `POSTS_PER_PAGE = 12`, real `count()`).
- **Cover images:** `BlogPost.coverImage` plain string; `scripts/blog-image-backfill.mjs` assigns
  topic-matched real product screenshots (from `/blog/screenshots/`) to `seobatch`-tagged posts, keyword-

  in `lib/blog.ts`, which also contains a self-written zero-dependency markdown→HTML renderer.
- **`#seobatch` leak — confirmed still live.** 233 of 346 posts carry the `seobatch` tag.
  `components/marketing/blogtemplate/BlogPostView.tsx` (lines ~370–377) renders every tag as a visible
  `#tag` chip with no filtering, so the literal text **"#seobatch"** shows on the public page for those
  233 posts. It also leaks into `<meta>`/OpenGraph (`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` line ~50 passes `post.tags`
  straight into `generateMetadata`'s `openGraph.tags`) and into a "Covers" quick-fact using the first 3
  tags (line ~74). This matches exactly what `OPEN-ITEMS.md §C` flags as a live-site bug — it is real and
  unfixed, and the new template (`build_blogpost.py`) must filter `seobatch` (and any other internal-only
  tag) before rendering tags anywhere, or it will carry the same leak forward.

## 5. Conversion paths — exact hrefs and params

- **Signup / login:** `/register` and `/login` (`app/register/page.tsx`, `app/login/page.tsx`), both
  accept `?next=<url>&error=<code>`. `next` is validated by `lib/safe-next.ts`'s `safeNext()` before use.
  Google SSO is a button inside `components/AuthForms.tsx` that already carries the resolved `next` — no
  reason for a marketing CTA to hit `/api/auth/google` directly. Every live marketing "Get started"/
  "Deploy"/"Sign up" CTA is a bare `Link href="/register"` (no `?plan=`); plan/game selection instead rides
  on the deploy-wizard URL passed through `next=`.
- **Deploy wizard:** `/dashboard/deploy` (login-gated, `requireUser()`). Canonical query-param contract is
  `lib/deploy-intent.ts`'s `DEPLOY_PARAM` map, built via `deployHref(intent)`:
  - `product`: `vps | game | hosting | email`
  - `plan`: `Plan.id` (VPS)
  - `term`: months (1, 12, or fixed biennial/triennial values)
  - `region`: region key matching `lib/nx/catalog.ts`'s `regionsFrom()` output
  - `addons`: comma-joined subset of `backup,malware,docker,ip`
  - `disk`: extra GB (VPS only)
  - `family`: game family key from `lib/games.ts` (e.g. `minecraft`, not the display name)
  - `tier`: exact `GamePlan.id` (preferred over `players`)
  - `variant`, `players`, `hosting` (`HostingPlan.id`), `email` (`EmailPlan.id`), `coupon`
  - Example: `/dashboard/deploy?product=game&family=minecraft&tier=<id>&term=12&region=sgp`
  - **Logged-out CTA pattern:** `/register?next=%2Fdashboard%2Fdeploy%3Fproduct%3Dgame%26family%3Dminecraft`
    (URL-encoded `next`) — both `/register` and `/login` preserve it through signup/OAuth.
- **Checkout/Stripe:** `app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts` is **wallet top-up only**
  (`createTopUpPaymentSession`, $5–$5000, no plan/order metadata). Real order checkout happens inside the
  deploy wizard's embedded Stripe Elements once an `Order` exists server-side — **there is no marketing-
  page-reachable pre-filled Stripe checkout link.** The only pre-fill surface is the `/dashboard/deploy`
  query string above.
- **Free Minecraft / Free VPS:** `/free-minecraft` and `/free-vps` (`app/(marketing)/...`). CTAs use
  `CLAIM_HREF`/`UPGRADE_HREF` constants in `components/marketing/freetiertemplate/FreeTierTemplate.tsx` —
  plain static hrefs into `/register`/dashboard, not parameterized. Free VPS has no dedicated claim route;
  it's an in-dashboard promo claim reached via the standard signup flow.
- **Partner/referral:** `/partner/<code>` (`app/partner/[code]/route.ts`) and a legacy/parallel
  `/r/<code>` (`app/r/[code]/route.ts`) — both record a `ReferralClick`, set cookie **`nxeon_ref`**
  (30-day, `sameSite: lax`), 302→`/register`. No bare `?ref=` route exists server-side; that's handled
  client-side by `ReferralCapture` on `/register`. Code validation happens later, in `register`
  (`lib/actions.ts`), not at click time.
- **Promo codes:** entered as a form field (`CouponField`) or via the wizard's `coupon` param
  (`deployHref`'s `couponCode` → `?coupon=`) — no generic `?promo=` that feeds checkout directly.
- **Riddle:** `/riddle` (`app/riddle/page.tsx`), login-gated, form-submit only via server action
  (`submitAnswer`), no query params — link straight to `/riddle`, it will bounce through
  `/login?next=/riddle` if logged out.
- **Win-back:** `worker/deploy-winback.ts` emails link to plain `${APP_URL}/dashboard/deploy` (no query
  params); `WINBACK_COUPON_CODE = "COMEBACK50"` is shown as text only, typed in manually. A marketing page
  replicating this needs nothing more than a bare `/dashboard/deploy` link plus visible coupon text.

**Every new-site CTA should resolve to one of:** `/register?next=...`, `/login?next=...`,
`/dashboard/deploy?<DEPLOY_PARAM keys>`, `/contact?topic=...` (see §6 — needs a mapping decision),
`/partner/<code>`, or `/riddle`. None of the new dist pages currently encode any of these params — the
buttons in `dist/*.html` point at other `dist/*.html` files via `docs/url-map.json`'s temporary preview
URLs.

# Backend wiring gaps — new static marketing site vs live Nxeon platform

Scope: read-only audit. Compares the live Next.js app at `/opt/nxeon` (branch `main`) against the static
design package at `/root/nxeon-marketing-v1/src/New Marketing Website v1/nxeon-website-handoff/`
(`dist/` = 31 approved standalone HTML pages, `source/` = Python build system + baked JSON snapshots,
`docs/HANDOFF.md` + `docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md` = the design team's own notes). Nothing was changed; no build was run.

All live-side facts below were confirmed by reading source under `/opt/nxeon` and, where noted, a live
read-only query against the production Postgres DB `nxeon` on 2026-09-27. All counts are as of that date
and will drift (mods/blog/games catalogs grow continuously) — treat exact counts as "true as of this audit,"
not permanent.

---

## 1. Catalog data — plans, prices, games, regions, stock

### Plans & pricing
- **Prisma models** (`prisma/schema.prisma`): `Plan` (VPS, line ~639), `GamePlan` (per-game tier, line ~3047,
  FK `basePlanId` → `Plan` for provisioning size only — price/RAM/disk/slots live on `GamePlan` itself),
  `HostingPlan` (~1877, shared hosting), `EmailPlan` (~2657, business email). Common shape: `priceCents`,
  `introPriceCents`/`introTermMonths` (grandfather-program intro pricing), `active`, `sortOrder`.
- **Live counts (DB, 2026-09-27):** 4 active `Plan` rows, 3 active `HostingPlan`, 3 active `EmailPlan`,
  **135 active `GamePlan` rows across 47 game families** (of 52 families defined in `lib/games.ts`).
- **Renewal/actual-charge logic:** `lib/renewal-charge.ts`, single function `renewalCharge(server, prices)`.
  Order: resolve term → resolve price (per-customer `Server.grandfatheredRenewalCents` override beats the
  live `plan.priceCents`/`gamePlan.priceCents`) → apply annual-term discount from `lib/billing-terms.ts`
  → add IP/disk/backup add-ons → subtract one-time retention discount (`Server.pendingRenewalDiscountPercent`)
  → subtract Creator Partner recurring discount (`lib/partner-discount.ts` `partnerDiscountCentsFor`) → add
  tax. File comment explicitly warns this is the *one* formula after a past incident duplicated it and
  undercharged live customers — **any new pricing surface must call this, never re-derive a number.**
- **Annual discount:** global admin `Setting` `annual_discount_percent`, resolved via
  `lib/annual-discount.ts` → `annualDiscountPct()`. Not per-plan.
- **Promotions:** `lib/promotions.ts` — single promo model `FIRST_MONTH_FREE` (100% off first term),
  `currentPromo(now)` / `promoPriceCents()` / `discountedCents()`. Scope-gated to **shared hosting only**
  via `lib/promo-redemption.ts`'s `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo("HOSTING")` (per memory: hosting-only, never VPS/
  game/email — new marketing copy must not imply otherwise).
- **Geo display currency:** `geoip-lite` is in `next.config.ts`'s `serverExternalPackages` (line ~91).
  Flow: `lib/geo-ip.ts` (`countryFromRequestIp`) + `lib/geo-currency.ts` (`currencyForCountry`,
  `countryFromHeaders`) → `lib/currency-display.ts`'s `resolveDisplayCurrency()` (precedence: cookie > CDN
  header > geoip-lite IP > admin default `Setting`). **Display only — charges are always USD**
  (documented in the file itself). The live marketing `/pricing` page does **not** call this; it renders
  raw USD cents. The switcher lives in `components/currency/CurrencySwitcher.tsx` +
  `components/currency/CurrencyContext.tsx` (cookie-persisted), used via `useDisplayMoney()`.
- **Marketing pricing page today:** `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx`, `export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic"`. Queries `db.plan.findMany({where:{active:true}})`, `db.hostingPlan.findMany(...)`,
  `db.emailPlan.findMany(...)`, `db.gamePlan.findMany(...)` live, plus `annualDiscountPct()`,
  `backupPlusMonthlyCents()`, `extraDiskPerGbCents()`, `planIntroMonthlyCents()` (`lib/intro-pricing.ts`).
  Feeds `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. **Nothing here is static — every number is a live
  read.** This is the target the new `/pricing` page must reproduce, not a config file to copy values from.

### New site's pricing today
`dist/nxeon-pricing.html` (built by `source/pages/pricing/`, `meta.json` + hand-typed content) has the
Minecraft tier prices (1 GB $2.99 … 16 GB $32.99) explicitly flagged in `OPEN-ITEMS.md §A.1` as **preview
figures**; only Valheim's are marked live. CPU/NVMe specs per tier (`SPEC` in `source/build_gs2.py`) are
explicitly flagged as **placeholders modelled on VPS plans**, not real `GamePlan` data. **Nothing in the
new site queries the DB — every number is baked at build time into static HTML.**

### Games catalog
- Canonical list: `lib/games.ts` — `GAME_FAMILIES` (52 entries, static TS array, **no `Game` DB model
  exists** — confirmed via schema grep) + `GAME_DISPLAY` (name/glyph map). There is no export literally
  named `GAME_META`; related exports used elsewhere are `GAME_DISPLAY`, `GAME_PORT`, `GAME_ART_SLUG`,
  `GAME_GENRES`, and `ACTIVE_GAME_FAMILIES` (41, in `lib/marketing/gameLocationLandings.ts`).
  `lib/nx/catalog.ts` even has a `GAMES_COUNT_BULLET = "__GAMES_COUNT__ supported games"` placeholder
  substituted at render time — a comment there says this replaced a **previously hardcoded wrong count**
  ("41 supported games"). This is the exact bug pattern the new static site risks repeating.
- New site: `source/pages/nxlabs/games.json` (1,578 bytes, small fixed list) and the game-server pricing
  panel's `MC`/`TIERS` dicts in `source/build_gameserver.py` — static, will not track `lib/games.ts` or
  `GamePlan` as either changes.

### Regions / nodes / stock
- **`Node` model** (schema ~line 1486): `region` (free string, validated in code via
  `lib/node-regions.ts`, not a DB enum), `provider` (`NodeProvider`: OVH/HETZNER), `capacityRamMB`,
  `enabled`, `acceptsProvisions`, `status`.
- **Live reality (DB):** 4 `Node` rows — 3 in `sgp1` (OVH, incl. `primary`) + 1 in `fsn1` (Hetzner) =
  **2 distinct live regions today: Singapore and Falkenstein, Germany.**
- Deploy wizard region picker (`app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx`): `db.node.findMany({enabled:true})` read
  live, per request → `lib/nx/catalog.ts`'s `regionsFrom(nodes)` groups by region (only regions with
  `COORDS[region]` defined show up) → `defaultRegionKey()` geo-picks the nearest.
- **Stock/availability:** `lib/node-capacity.ts` computes per-node CPU/RAM/disk utilization with
  warn/crit thresholds, but that surface is **admin-only** (`/admin/infrastructure`, `NodeAlert` model) —
  it is never exposed to the marketing site or the deploy wizard. There is **no customer-facing "N slots
  left" or "sold out" concept anywhere** in the live product. `acceptsProvisions` and real capacity are
  enforced later, server-side, by the worker/scheduler — not surfaced as a stock signal to the buyer.
- **New site:** the homepage "global network" section (per `OPEN-ITEMS.md §C`) lists 7 regions (Toronto,
  New York, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney) — **5 of these don't exist as live `Node`
  regions today.** This is a live-site inconsistency the design docs flag but haven't resolved; a rebuild
  must decide the real, honest region list (Singapore + Falkenstein, or Falkenstein under a "Germany"
  label) rather than porting the aspirational 7-region copy forward.

**Every number on the new pricing/game/VPS pages must ultimately come from:** `db.plan`, `db.gamePlan`,
`db.hostingPlan`, `db.emailPlan` (via the same query shapes as `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx`),
`lib/annual-discount.ts`, `lib/intro-pricing.ts`, `lib/renewal-charge.ts` (for any "then $X/mo after intro"
copy), `lib/games.ts` for the game list, and `db.node` (`enabled:true`) for regions — never a snapshot.

---

## 2. Mods / NxLabs

### Live system
- **Prisma models:** `GameMod` (schema ~3078) — `gameFamily, name, slug, category, source, sourceId, url,
  description, iconUrl, popularity, paid, featured, active`, plus verified-upstream fields
  (`gameVersions[]`, `loaders[]`, `downloads`, `fileBytes`, `dependencyCount`, `serverSide`, `impact`,
  `license`, `galleryUrls[]`, `authorName`, `longDescription`, `upstreamUpdatedAt`, etc.), unique on
  `(gameFamily, slug)`. `ModRating` (~3219, 1–5 stars, unique per user/mod). `ServerMod` (install state per
  server, driven by worker jobs `GAME_MOD_INSTALL`/`GAME_MOD_UNINSTALL`).
- **Importers** (`scripts/`): `import-modrinth-catalog.ts`, `import-thunderstore-catalog.ts`,
  `verify-gamemods.ts`, `backfill-modrinth-descriptions.ts`, `backfill-upstream-updated.ts`. **No systemd
  timer runs any of them** — they're run manually/ad hoc, not on a schedule (checked
  `systemctl list-timers` and every `*nxeon*` unit file).
- **Real counts (DB, 2026-09-27): 64,714 `GameMod` rows across 33 game families.** Breakdown by family:
  minecraft 32,252, factorio 5,446, vintagestory 3,934, spaceengineers 2,168, valheim 1,243, cs2 1,013,
  and ~1,000 each for palworld/ark/barotrauma/dst/empyrion/kf2/l4d2/projectzomboid/terraria/tf2/unturned,
  long tail down to cs16 (9). By source: modrinth 32,243, steam_workshop 18,349, factorio_portal 5,446,
  vintagestory_moddb 3,934, mod_io 2,884, thunderstore 1,776, github 33, umod 29, nexus 12, spigotmc 7,
  codefling 1. Only 33 of `lib/games.ts`'s 52 families have any mods.
- **Routes** (`app/(marketing)/mods/`): `mods/page.tsx` (hub, `force-dynamic`, `?q=&sort=&page=`),
  `mods/games/[family]/page.tsx` (`generateStaticParams()` from `listCatalogFamilies()` — only the 33
  populated families get a page), `mods/[family]/[slug]/page.tsx` (detail, `generateStaticParams()` from
  `listCatalogSlugs()`). All query logic lives in `lib/mods-catalog.ts`: `queryCatalogMods`,
  `listCatalogFamilies`, `listFeaturedMods`, `listTopDownloadedMods`, `listRecentlyUpdatedMods`,
  `listTopRatedMods`, `totalDownloadsFor`, `getCatalogMod`, `relatedCatalogMods`, `recommendedPlanFor`,
  `resolveDownloadUrl`, `listModComments`, `getMyModRating`, `renderModBody`.
- **Search/pagination:** real DB `skip`/`take` + `count()`, page size `CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE = 24` — rewritten
  2026-09-19 specifically because the catalog outgrew an earlier 400-row in-memory cap. Aggregates
  (`listCatalogFamilies`, `totalDownloadsFor`) use `unstable_cache` (600s revalidate); pages are dynamic.

### New site
`source/pages/nxlabs/mods.json` (4.7 KB), `source/pages/nxlabs/games.json` (1.6 KB),
`source/pages/mc_catalog.json` (2.1 KB, **zero `"slug"` keys found** — appears to be a tiny sample/spec
file, not real catalog rows). `dist/nxeon-mod-lithium.html` is one hand-built detail page (Lithium, from
`build_modpage.py`'s hardcoded `LITHIUM` dict + `mod_tags.py`). `dist/nxeon-mods-minecraft.html` and
`dist/nxeon-mods-minecraft-browse.html` cover exactly one game (Minecraft) with baked sample cards.

**Gap:** the snapshots are ~4–5 KB vs. a live table of 64,714 rows across 33 games. Generating "ALL real
mod pages" means replacing every baked JSON with live calls into `lib/mods-catalog.ts` (or a thin wrapper
around it) for: the hub, all 33 `mods/games/[family]` pages, and all mod-detail pages — this cannot be a
build-time snapshot at all, or it goes stale (and undersized) the moment it ships.

---

## 3. Blog

### Live system
- **Storage:** `BlogPost` Prisma model (schema ~2574) — no MDX. Fields: `slug` (unique), `title`,
  `excerpt`, `body` (markdown string), `coverEmoji?`, `coverImage?`, `tags[]`, `author` (default "Nxeon"),
  `category` (default "Guides"), `published`, `publishedAt?`, `seoTitle?`, `seoDescription?`.
- **Real count: 346 published posts** (grew from the ~200 shipped 2026-08-04). By category: Gaming 133,
  Tutorials 82, Security 34, Domains 30, Networking 16, Comparisons 11, Guides 10, Email 9, VPS 9,
  Hosting 7, Control Panels 4, Game servers 1.
- **No dedicated `/blog/category/[cat]` route** — category is a display label only, not a filterable URL.
- **Search:** real server-side Prisma in `lib/blog.ts` (`searchPublishedPosts`/`publishedWhere`,
  case-insensitive `contains` across title/excerpt/body/category + exact tag match), paginated
  (`getPostsPage`, `POSTS_PER_PAGE = 12`, real `count()`).
- **Cover images:** `BlogPost.coverImage` plain string; `scripts/blog-image-backfill.mjs` assigns
  topic-matched real product screenshots (from `/blog/screenshots/`) to `seobatch`-tagged posts, keyword-
  scored against title/tags/category — no AI-generated art.
- **Routes:** hub `app/blog/page.tsx` (note: **not** under the `(marketing)` route group), detail
  `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, admin editor `app/admin/blog/page.tsx`. `getPublishedPost`/`getRelatedPosts`
  in `lib/blog.ts`, which also contains a self-written zero-dependency markdown→HTML renderer.
- **`#seobatch` leak — confirmed still live.** 233 of 346 posts carry the `seobatch` tag.
  `components/marketing/blogtemplate/BlogPostView.tsx` (lines ~370–377) renders every tag as a visible
  `#tag` chip with no filtering, so the literal text **"#seobatch"** shows on the public page for those
  233 posts. It also leaks into `<meta>`/OpenGraph (`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` line ~50 passes `post.tags`
  straight into `generateMetadata`'s `openGraph.tags`) and into a "Covers" quick-fact using the first 3
  tags (line ~74). This matches exactly what `OPEN-ITEMS.md §C` flags as a live-site bug — it is real and
  unfixed, and the new template (`build_blogpost.py`) must filter `seobatch` (and any other internal-only
  tag) before rendering tags anywhere, or it will carry the same leak forward.

### New site
`dist/nxeon-blog.html` (hub, `build_bloghub.py`'s hardcoded `P` list, 25 "real guides" per the docs) and
`dist/nxeon-blog-vaultwarden-nginx.html` (one article, `build_blogpost.py`'s hardcoded `A` dict). Cover
visual system (`build_blogvisuals.py`) picks an archetype (flow/terminal/shield/stack/vault/chart/route) +
Simple Icons logo (`source/pages/_logos.json`, 19 KB) + category palette per guide — this part is a
genuinely reusable algorithm, not a snapshot, and can likely be ported as-is and driven by `BlogPost.tags`
+ `BlogPost.category` at render/build time.

**Gap:** needs a real listing/detail/search/pagination layer against `BlogPost` (reuse `lib/blog.ts`)
covering all 346 posts, a category-page decision (none exists live to copy — this would be new), and the
`seobatch` tag filtered out of any rendered tag list wherever the new template borrows the pattern.

## 5. Conversion paths — exact hrefs and params

- **Signup / login:** `/register` and `/login` (`app/register/page.tsx`, `app/login/page.tsx`), both
  accept `?next=<url>&error=<code>`. `next` is validated by `lib/safe-next.ts`'s `safeNext()` before use.
  Google SSO is a button inside `components/AuthForms.tsx` that already carries the resolved `next` — no
  reason for a marketing CTA to hit `/api/auth/google` directly. Every live marketing "Get started"/
  "Deploy"/"Sign up" CTA is a bare `Link href="/register"` (no `?plan=`); plan/game selection instead rides
  on the deploy-wizard URL passed through `next=`.
- **Deploy wizard:** `/dashboard/deploy` (login-gated, `requireUser()`). Canonical query-param contract is
  `lib/deploy-intent.ts`'s `DEPLOY_PARAM` map, built via `deployHref(intent)`:
  - `product`: `vps | game | hosting | email`
  - `plan`: `Plan.id` (VPS)
  - `term`: months (1, 12, or fixed biennial/triennial values)
  - `region`: region key matching `lib/nx/catalog.ts`'s `regionsFrom()` output
  - `addons`: comma-joined subset of `backup,malware,docker,ip`
  - `disk`: extra GB (VPS only)
  - `family`: game family key from `lib/games.ts` (e.g. `minecraft`, not the display name)
  - `tier`: exact `GamePlan.id` (preferred over `players`)
  - `variant`, `players`, `hosting` (`HostingPlan.id`), `email` (`EmailPlan.id`), `coupon`
  - Example: `/dashboard/deploy?product=game&family=minecraft&tier=<id>&term=12&region=sgp`
  - **Logged-out CTA pattern:** `/register?next=%2Fdashboard%2Fdeploy%3Fproduct%3Dgame%26family%3Dminecraft`
    (URL-encoded `next`) — both `/register` and `/login` preserve it through signup/OAuth.
- **Checkout/Stripe:** `app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts` is **wallet top-up only**
  (`createTopUpPaymentSession`, $5–$5000, no plan/order metadata). Real order checkout happens inside the
  deploy wizard's embedded Stripe Elements once an `Order` exists server-side — **there is no marketing-
  page-reachable pre-filled Stripe checkout link.** The only pre-fill surface is the `/dashboard/deploy`
  query string above.
- **Free Minecraft / Free VPS:** `/free-minecraft` and `/free-vps` (`app/(marketing)/...`). CTAs use
  `CLAIM_HREF`/`UPGRADE_HREF` constants in `components/marketing/freetiertemplate/FreeTierTemplate.tsx` —
  plain static hrefs into `/register`/dashboard, not parameterized. Free VPS has no dedicated claim route;
  it's an in-dashboard promo claim reached via the standard signup flow.
- **Partner/referral:** `/partner/<code>` (`app/partner/[code]/route.ts`) and a legacy/parallel
  `/r/<code>` (`app/r/[code]/route.ts`) — both record a `ReferralClick`, set cookie **`nxeon_ref`**
  (30-day, `sameSite: lax`), 302→`/register`. No bare `?ref=` route exists server-side; that's handled
  client-side by `ReferralCapture` on `/register`. Code validation happens later, in `register`
  (`lib/actions.ts`), not at click time.
- **Promo codes:** entered as a form field (`CouponField`) or via the wizard's `coupon` param
  (`deployHref`'s `couponCode` → `?coupon=`) — no generic `?promo=` that feeds checkout directly.
- **Riddle:** `/riddle` (`app/riddle/page.tsx`), login-gated, form-submit only via server action
  (`submitAnswer`), no query params — link straight to `/riddle`, it will bounce through
  `/login?next=/riddle` if logged out.
- **Win-back:** `worker/deploy-winback.ts` emails link to plain `${APP_URL}/dashboard/deploy` (no query
  params); `WINBACK_COUPON_CODE = "COMEBACK50"` is shown as text only, typed in manually. A marketing page
  replicating this needs nothing more than a bare `/dashboard/deploy` link plus visible coupon text.

**Every new-site CTA should resolve to one of:** `/register?next=...`, `/login?next=...`,
`/dashboard/deploy?<DEPLOY_PARAM keys>`, `/contact?topic=...` (see §6 — needs a mapping decision),
`/partner/<code>`, or `/riddle`. None of the new dist pages currently encode any of these params — the
buttons in `dist/*.html` point at other `dist/*.html` files via `docs/url-map.json`'s temporary preview
URLs.

---

## 6. Forms & support

- **Contact form:** `app/(marketing)/contact/page.tsx` → `components/marketing/ContactRoutingForm.tsx`
  (client) → server action `submitContact()` in `lib/actions-contact.ts`. Fields: `name`, `email`,
  `category`, `message`, `company` (honeypot). Categories: `lib/contact-categories.ts`'s
  `CONTACT_CATEGORIES` — **`support | bug | sales | billing | general`** (5, via `CONTACT_CATEGORY_ORDER`),
  each mapped to a mailbox local-part resolved against `supportEmail()` (`lib/settings.ts`). Validates with
  zod, rate-limits 5/10min by IP+email, sends HTML mail via `lib/mailer.ts`'s `sendMail()` (Reply-To =
  sender), and **always** persists a `ContactMessage` row regardless of email delivery.
  **`?topic=` deep-linking does not exist live at all** — the page never reads `searchParams`; category
  defaults to `"support"` and must be clicked manually. The new site's proposed topic vocabulary
  (`custom|migrate|partner|vps|game|support|billing|bug|general`) does **not** 1:1 match the live 5
  categories — `custom`, `migrate`, `partner`, `vps`, `game` have no live category counterpart. This needs
  a product decision (extend `CONTACT_CATEGORIES`, or map the new topics down onto the existing 5) before
  `?topic=` can be wired, not just plumbing work.
- **Live chat:** two unrelated systems both mount in `app/layout.tsx`. `components/marketing/LiveChat.tsx`
  is a dead/optional 3rd-party snippet slot (Crisp/tawk.to via Setting or env var) — currently unconfigured,
  renders nothing. `components/ChatWidget.tsx` is the real first-party AI+human system, backed by
  `app/api/chat/route.ts`, `ChatConversation`/`ChatMessage` models, AI layer `lib/kb-run.ts`'s
  `runAssistant()` → `lib/anthropic.ts`. **Confirmed still blocked:** no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in `.env`, and
  `lib/kb-run.ts` gates the bot on `Setting kb_bot_enabled` (defaults `"false"`) — both unconfigured and
  disabled. Human escalation and Discord mirroring (`lib/discord-bridge.ts`) work regardless.
- **Newsletter:** real and live — `components/marketing/NewsletterSignup.tsx` → server action
  `subscribe()` in `lib/actions-newsletter.ts`, mounted in the footer and a couple of pages, with an admin
  composer (`app/admin/newsletter/page.tsx`) and campaign send (`lib/actions-newsletter-campaign.ts`) plus
  unsubscribe (`lib/marketing-unsub.ts`). The new site's footer newsletter field should call this action.
- **Feature request:** `components/FeedbackWidget.tsx` → `lib/actions-feedback.ts`'s `submitFeedback()`
  exists, but is **only mounted behind login** (old portal shell + dashboard) — there is **no public,
  unauthenticated feature-request path** on the marketing site today.
- **Status page:** `/status` (`app/status/page.tsx`) — real data via `lib/monitoring.ts` (`getHealth`,
  `overallStatus`, `uptimeSummary`, `allTimelines`, `listIncidents`), `force-dynamic`, client polls every
  15s. Not fabricated.
- **Help center / KB:** **exists live** at `/help` (`app/help/page.tsx` + `lib/help.ts`'s `getHelpData()`),
  built on top of `BlogPost`, with category browsing and search (`?q=`, `?c=`) — this contradicts
  `OPEN-ITEMS.md §B`'s framing that "Docs" and a help surface are new designs still needed; a real one
  already exists and should be ported, not invented.

---

## 7. Tracking & compliance

- **Visitor tracking:** `components/VisitTracker.tsx` (mounted in `app/(marketing)/layout.tsx`) POSTs
  pageview + `sendBeacon` dwell/close events to `app/api/track/route.ts` → `Visit` rows (UA-parsed via
  `lib/ua-parse.ts`, bot-filtered, consent-gated `nx_vid` cookie). Deploy-funnel:
  `lib/deploy-funnel-client.ts` → `app/api/track/deploy-step/route.ts` → `DeployFunnelEvent`.
- **Meta Pixel/CAPI:** `components/marketing/ConversionTags.tsx` (browser tags) +
  `components/marketing/MetaPixelTracker.tsx` (SPA PageView re-fire, `_fbc` cookie backfill, mounted in
  `app/layout.tsx`); server CAPI config in `lib/tracking.ts`. Inert until Settings-based IDs/tokens exist.
- **Google Ads conversions:** `lib/google-ads.ts`'s `recordAdsConversion()` queues `AdsConversion` rows by
  `gclid` (captured in `/api/track`), uploaded by a worker sweep `googleAdsConversionSweep()`. Inert until
  credentials configured (per memory, still pending real API creds).
- **Cookie consent:** exists, opt-out model (not a hard gate) — `components/marketing/CookieConsent.tsx` +
  `lib/consent.ts` (`marketingAllowed()`, `hasCookieConsent()`), default tracking-ON, "Got it" vs "Opt out",
  persisted 1yr in `nxeon_cookie_consent`.
- **Legal pages — all exist live:** `app/legal/terms/page.tsx`, `app/legal/privacy/page.tsx`,
  `app/legal/aup/page.tsx`, `app/legal/sla/page.tsx` (shared `app/legal/layout.tsx`). **`OPEN-ITEMS.md §B`
  lists "Legal: Terms, Privacy, Acceptable Use and SLA" as pages still to build — this is wrong; all four
  exist live today and just need visual porting, not content creation.**
- **Structured data / discovery files:** `app/sitemap.ts` (chunked `generateSitemaps()`, ~45k mod URLs
  force the split) + hand-built index `app/sitemap.xml/route.ts`; `app/robots.ts` (disallows
  `/dashboard /admin /api /login /register /forgot-password /reset-password` + one promo path);
  `app/llms.txt/route.ts` (a live route handler generating current pricing/catalog facts, not a static
  file — the new site needs an equivalent, not a copy). JSON-LD is scattered per-page (confirmed in
  `free-minecraft`, mod detail, `[slug]`, `tools` pages), not centralized.
- **OG images:** dynamic, `app/opengraph-image.tsx` via `next/og`'s `ImageResponse` (1200×630 brand
  gradient card) — no static fallback needed, this can be reused as-is for new routes.

  (`/revsports` → `/`) plus SEO consolidation redirects for duplicate blog/game slugs. Custom 404:
  `app/not-found.tsx`.

## 8. Auth-aware UI

- **Header auth state:** `components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx` — client-side `authed` flag, resolved
  in two steps: instant optimistic read of a non-httpOnly `nxeon_authed` cookie, then corrected by a fetch
  to `GET /api/auth/status` (authoritative server session check). Swaps Login/Signup for a "back to
  portal"/dashboard-link CTA in three places (desktop nav, mobile drawer, CTA button). **No wallet balance
  shown in the header.** New nav's "My account / Back to portal" slot (per `OPEN-ITEMS.md §A.8`) should
  reuse this exact `authed` + `/api/auth/status` pattern, not a new auth check.
- **Currency switcher:** `components/currency/CurrencySwitcher.tsx` + `CurrencyContext.tsx`, cookie-
  persisted, pre-seeded from IP via `lib/geo-currency.ts`'s `COUNTRY_TO_CURRENCY` + `lib/geo-ip.ts`
  (geoip-lite). Real and reusable as-is.
- **Region detection UI:** no dedicated "detected region" element exists; the only near-hit is a static
  copy string in `components/marketing/nxcloudtemplate/NxCloudLanding.tsx` ("pooled · your region") that
  is not a live geo readout.
